_about: Spec (unofficial) hyper-personalized video ads for real San Francisco brands, for a public hackathon experiment. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any brand named here. Facts in hero shots and lines come from the linked sources; no offers or prices are invented. render.py compiles product + persona + variant into one FLUX 3 prompt (POST /v1/flux-3-video, mode t2v). Audio (music, SFX, dialogue) is controlled only through prompt text; dialogue in double quotes is spoken.

sightglass.name: Sightglass Coffee
sightglass.category: specialty coffee roaster, flagship roastery and coffee bar at 270 7th St, SoMa
sightglass.look: bright airy look, tall industrial windows, soft morning light on wood and steel, shallow depth of field
sightglass.hero: inside a lofty roastery with a coffee roaster turning in the background, a barista pours a pour-over into a ceramic cup, steam rising in a shaft of window light
sightglass.sfx: the low rumble of a coffee roaster, beans crackling, a cup set down on a wooden bar
sightglass.sonic_logo: a soft two-note upright bass pluck on the final frame

tartine.name: Tartine Bakery
tartine.category: Mission bakery at 600 Guerrero St, known for morning buns, croissants and country bread
tartine.look: warm golden look, natural light, crumbs and flaky pastry in macro detail, handheld intimate framing
tartine.hero: a hand tears open a caramelized, orange-zested morning bun, sugar glistening, steam curling off it, a dark-crusted round country loaf behind it
tartine.sfx: a crackling crust, a paper bag rustling open
tartine.sonic_logo: a warm three-note acoustic guitar figure on the final frame

bi_rite_creamery.name: Bi-Rite Creamery
bi_rite_creamery.category: small-batch ice cream shop at 3692 18th St by Dolores Park, open since 2006, famous for Salted Caramel
bi_rite_creamery.look: sun-drenched summer look, saturated colors, playful handheld energy, lens flare
bi_rite_creamery.hero: a scoop of glossy salted caramel ice cream pressed into a cone, a caramel ribbon folding through it, slow motion
bi_rite_creamery.sfx: a scoop scraping, a cone crunch, distant happy crowd chatter
bi_rite_creamery.sonic_logo: a bright ukulele strum on the final frame

dandelion.name: Dandelion Chocolate
dandelion.category: bean-to-bar chocolate factory and cafe at 740 Valencia St since 2012
dandelion.look: rich cocoa-brown and cream palette, cozy evening interior light, macro texture on chocolate
dandelion.hero: a thick single-origin hot chocolate poured into a small cup, cocoa beans and a snapped chocolate bar on the counter, chocolate makers working in the background
dandelion.sfx: a crisp chocolate snap, a thick velvety pour, a quiet cafe murmur
dandelion.sonic_logo: a gentle Rhodes piano chord on the final frame

boudin.name: Boudin Bakery
boudin.category: San Francisco sourdough bakery founded in 1849, still baking from its original mother dough
boudin.look: moody silver-blue fog look with warm bakery amber highlights, documentary texture
boudin.hero: a golden sourdough loaf scored and pulled from the oven, crust crackling, then torn open to reveal an airy tangy crumb
boudin.sfx: foghorns in the distance, an oven door creaking open, crust crackling as it cools
boudin.sonic_logo: a low foghorn note blending into a warm brass chord on the final frame

sutro_stack.name: Sutro Stack
sutro_stack.category: fictional San Francisco burger shop, invented for this experiment (no real brand)
sutro_stack.look: punchy social-feed look, fast cuts, saturated warm colors, crisp commercial food lighting
sutro_stack.hero: a juicy double smash burger on a toasted sourdough bun, crispy lacy beef edges, melted cheddar dripping, grilled onions, pickles and garlic aioli, slow-motion clean product close-up
sutro_stack.sfx: phone notification pings, swipe whooshes, a sizzle on a flat-top grill, a crunchy first bite
sutro_stack.sonic_logo: a short upbeat five-note whistle-and-horn sting on the final frame

soma_lunch.where: SoMa, San Francisco: brick warehouses, glass offices, Bay Bridge in the distance
soma_lunch.when: weekday lunch hour, mostly sunny and warm
soma_lunch.voice: an energetic, friendly young narrator with fast social-media pacing, American English
soma_lunch.music: upbeat trending-style hip hop beat with snappy hi-hats and a bass drop at the reveal

data.fact: viral SF story: a prediction market's charity arm hired a former FTX figure and had spent FTX money

variants.tension: she mouths her pitch to herself on the sidewalk, checks her phone, eight missed messages, exhales hard
variants.turn: she steps into the roastery and waits at the bar
variants.payoff: she walks out, cup in hand, shoulders back, striding toward the city with a small smile
lines: Demo day. Four minutes to make it count.
Sightglass. Roasted right here on 7th Street.

variants.tension: the streetcar doors close just as he reaches them, he sighs as fog swirls around him
variants.turn: later, downtown, he ducks out of the fog into the bright roastery
variants.payoff: he holds the warm cup in both hands by the window, fogged glass, finally awake
lines: Missed the train. Found the fog.
Sightglass. Worth the walk from the stop.

variants.tension: she jogs out of cold gray surf, shivering, peels down her wetsuit hood
variants.turn: wrapped in a towel on the back bumper of the van, she opens a warm paper bag
variants.payoff: she bites into the morning bun, eyes closed, sugar on her lips, waves rolling behind her
lines: Tartine morning bun. The real reward.

variants.tension: the friends spread a blanket on the slope and realize nobody brought food, groans and laughs
variants.turn: one friend jogs up holding a big round country loaf and a pastry box
variants.payoff: they tear the bread and pass it around, skyline behind, everyone talking at once
lines: Tartine. Around the corner from the park.

variants.tension: the sun beats down on the park, the friends fan themselves, one points toward 18th Street
variants.turn: they stand in a long cheerful line outside a small ice cream shop
variants.payoff: back on the hill, four cones clink together in a toast, the city glittering behind
lines: Hottest Sunday of the year. You know where the line is.
Bi-Rite Creamery. Twenty years on 18th Street.

variants.tension: the boy drags his feet, shows his mom a test paper with a gold star, looks up hopefully
variants.turn: she smiles and they turn the corner onto 18th Street
variants.payoff: sitting on a bench, the boy with ice cream on his nose, both laughing
lines: Una estrella de oro merece algo especial.
Bi-Rite Creamery. Aquí, en la calle 18.

variants.tension: evening, she leaves a glass office building, phone buzzing with a message that reads like good news, she stops and laughs in disbelief
variants.turn: she steps into a warm chocolate cafe on Valencia Street
variants.payoff: she raises the cup in a quiet solo toast, city lights in the window
lines: Dandelion Chocolate. Bean to bar, on Valencia since 2012.

variants.tension: she shivers in the fog, looks at her phone showing 58 degrees in July, looks at the camera in betrayal
variants.turn: she follows the smell of bread through a bakery doorway
variants.payoff: she holds a torn sourdough loaf, steam rising, finally grinning at the fog
lines: Nobody told me July would be this cold.
Boudin. San Francisco sourdough since 1849. The fog is part of the recipe.

variants.tension: the fog swallows the tops of buildings; people on the sidewalk below zip up their jackets and hunch their shoulders
variants.turn: the fog presses up against the tall windows of a bright roastery, curling against the glass as if peering in
variants.payoff: a woman steps out onto the sidewalk holding a warm cup, steam from the coffee rising and mixing with the fog around her
lines: Morning. It's me, the fog. Yes, again.
Sightglass on 7th Street. Even I stop by.

shots.shot: fast social-feed style montage of San Francisco lunch-hour street energy in sunny SoMa: brick warehouses, Bay Bridge in the distance, people on the sidewalk glancing at phones that light up, surprised reactions, quick whip pans
shots.vo: San Francisco's feed is all over a viral local headline.

shots.shot: abstract, stylized news-feed cards sliding past fast on a phone screen: shapes, a crypto coin icon, a briefcase icon, surprised emoji reactions, blurred unreadable text, no logos, no real faces, no names
shots.vo: From the headline everyone is sharing to the lunch everyone knows...

shots.shot: smash cut to a sizzling flat-top grill and a warm, craveable burger reveal: a double smash burger on a toasted sourdough bun, crispy beef edges, melted cheddar dripping, slow-motion clean product close-up
shots.vo: ...make your next lunch a Sutro Stack.

shots.shot: hero product shot of the sourdough smash burger on a table in bright sunshine against a sunny San Francisco backdrop with painted houses and blue sky, then it holds still for an end card with empty space at the top for text

continuations.prompt: Continue the same shot and character. She walks into a packed demo-day room, sets the coffee cup down on the podium, looks up at the audience and smiles. Same music continues and resolves. She says: "Okay. Let's begin."

Continue into the roastery behind him: a macro shot of freshly roasted coffee beans cascading out of a drum roaster into a cooling tray, stirring arms turning, smoke curling in window light. Sound of the roaster rumbling and beans crackling. The same narrator says: "Roasted right here on 7th Street."

Continue the same scene. The fog rapidly burns off and pulls back, bright sun floods the SoMa street, the woman with the coffee cup tilts her face up to the sun and smiles. The music swells into a bright brass flourish. The fog voice grumbles, fading away: "Fine. Enjoy your coffee outside."
